_comment: The permissions a reviewer needs, declared once. bootstrap.py builds a new
App's manifest from it, and mint-token.sh checks every minted token against
`consequence` is printed to whoever hits a shortfall, so it is addressed to
them: what stops working, not why the permission exists.

why.pull_requests: submit reviews, inline comments, thread replies
why.contents: read the diff; resolve threads; have the verdict counted at all
why.statuses: combined commit status, for CI that posts statuses instead of check runs

consequence.pull_requests: reviews and inline comments cannot be posted
consequence.contents: reviews post but do not count — GitHub leaves a review by an App without this out of latestOpinionatedReviews, so reviewDecision never moves and the merge box ignores the verdict. Resolving a thread also fails.
consequence.checks: check runs are invisible, so a red build reads as no build
consequence.actions: the rollup cannot dereference workflow runs
consequence.statuses: CI that posts commit statuses instead of check runs is invisible
